<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" class="k5o" role="img" aria-label="KSAB5, The Cinqo. Technical difficulties. Please stand by." font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <style><![CDATA[
    @font-face { font-family: 'K7 Bungee'; src: url(/shared/fonts/bungee.woff2) format('woff2'); font-display: swap; }
    @font-face { font-family: 'K7 Audiowide'; src: url(/shared/fonts/audiowide.woff2) format('woff2'); font-display: swap; }
    @font-face { font-family: 'K7 Shoulders'; src: url(/shared/fonts/big-shoulders-display.woff2) format('woff2'); font-weight: 800; font-display: swap; }
    .k5o-bungee { font-family: 'K7 Bungee', Impact, sans-serif; }
    .k5o-wide { font-family: 'K7 Audiowide', Bahnschrift, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }
    .k5o-tall { font-family: 'K7 Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', Impact, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; }
  ]]></style>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="k5o-bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0c2427"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#061416"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#020809"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="k5o-badge" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#5ff7e2"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#22b8a3"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="k5o-bar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffc56a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e8962c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="k5o-vig" cx="0.5" cy="0.45" r="0.75">
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="k5o-sweep" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3df0d8" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#3df0d8" stop-opacity="0.12"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#3df0d8" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="k5o-stripes" width="22" height="22" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(-24)">
      <rect width="11" height="22" fill="#3df0d8" opacity="0.035"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="k5o-scan" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="4" height="2" fill="#000" opacity="0.3"/>
    </pattern>
    <!-- Static from the dead line, crawling. -->
    <filter id="k5o-static" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.85" numOctaves="3" seed="5" result="n">
        <animate attributeName="seed" values="5;29;14;47;5" dur="0.45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </feTurbulence>
      <feColorMatrix in="n" type="saturate" values="0"/>
      <feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.5" intercept="-0.16"/></feComponentTransfer>
    </filter>
    <filter id="k5o-glow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="b"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
    <clipPath id="k5o-screen"><rect width="640" height="360" rx="9"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="k5o-crawl"><rect x="96" y="320" width="544" height="22"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <g clip-path="url(#k5o-screen)">
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#k5o-bg)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#k5o-stripes)"/>

    <!-- The logo: the 5 on the network's teal tab, the call letters, and The Cinqo under them. -->
    <g transform="translate(9 0)">
      <g filter="url(#k5o-glow)">
        <path d="M180 62H286L262 172H156Z" fill="url(#k5o-badge)">
          <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.82;1;1;0.9;1" dur="3.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </path>
        <text class="k5o-bungee" x="221" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-size="104" fill="#04100f">5</text>
      </g>
      <text class="k5o-tall" x="294" y="126" font-size="78" fill="#eafffb" textLength="168" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">KSAB</text>
      <rect x="294" y="138" width="168" height="1.5" fill="#3df0d8" opacity="0.6"/>
      <text class="k5o-wide" x="294" y="166" font-size="22" fill="#3df0d8" textLength="168" lengthAdjust="spacing">THE CINQO</text>
    </g>
    <text class="k5o-wide" x="320" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8.5" fill="#8fd9cd" letter-spacing="4.2" opacity="0.7">EVERY GAME · LIVE FROM THE GROUND</text>

    <!-- The message -->
    <path d="M118 210H530L522 242H110Z" fill="url(#k5o-bar)"/>
    <text class="k5o-tall" x="320" y="236" text-anchor="middle" font-size="27" fill="#1a0d02" letter-spacing="3.4">TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES</text>
    <text class="k5o-wide" x="320" y="264" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#ffd18a" letter-spacing="6">PLEASE STAND BY
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0.15;1" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </text>
    <text x="320" y="287" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#a6bfc0" letter-spacing="0.4">We've lost the picture from the ground. The game hasn't stopped.</text>
    <text x="320" y="303" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#7d9597" letter-spacing="0.4">Somebody has gone up the gantry to find out which cable it is.</text>

    <!-- The crawl: two copies of one line, each forced to 600 wide, so the loop has no seam. -->
    <rect x="0" y="320" width="640" height="22" fill="#030b0c" opacity="0.85"/>
    <rect x="0" y="320" width="640" height="1" fill="#3df0d8" opacity="0.45"/>
    <g clip-path="url(#k5o-crawl)">
      <g class="k5o-wide" font-size="9" fill="#8fd9cd" letter-spacing="1.6">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;-600 0" dur="22s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <text x="104" y="334.5" textLength="592" lengthAdjust="spacing">THE GAME IS STILL ON · SCORES WHEN WE'RE BACK · DON'T ADJUST YOUR SET · IT HAS NEVER HELPED ·</text>
        <text x="704" y="334.5" textLength="592" lengthAdjust="spacing">THE GAME IS STILL ON · SCORES WHEN WE'RE BACK · DON'T ADJUST YOUR SET · IT HAS NEVER HELPED ·</text>
      </g>
    </g>
    <path d="M0 320H90L84 342H0Z" fill="#3df0d8"/>
    <text class="k5o-tall" x="10" y="337" font-size="16" fill="#04100f" letter-spacing="0.8">KSAB5</text>
    <circle cx="73" cy="331" r="3" fill="#d24a3a">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0.08;1" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>

    <!-- Rolling frame-sync bar, grain, scanlines, vignette, flicker. -->
    <rect x="0" width="640" height="46" fill="url(#k5o-sweep)">
      <animate attributeName="y" values="-46;360" dur="7.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <rect width="640" height="360" filter="url(#k5o-static)" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#k5o-scan)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#k5o-vig)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="#000" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.08;0;0.04;0" dur="5.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="639" height="359" rx="9" fill="none" stroke="#1d3a3c" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>
description: KSAB5 off-air card: The Cinqo logo over TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES, with a crawl (SVG).
